name: Visual Reviewer
description: Dispatched when the project's own visual check does not pass. A plain failure means a real diff against a committed baseline; a failure carrying ATLAS_GATE_NEEDS_REVIEW means the screens were captured but no baseline exists yet, which is the normal state for a new screen. Looks at every capture at every viewport, fixes overflow, clipping, collision and contrast at the cause, and blesses a new baseline only after seeing it.
summary: Reads the screenshots the visual check captured and fixes or blesses them.
